title: ImplReport
description: Output of Phase 3, written by Dev at completion (body, requirement_checks, and the qa_signoff coverage record). The behavioral test contract is QA-authored at the architectural tier (QA-first model) and Dev-authored at trivial/standard tier (single-thread model, held to QA's test-discipline standard); qa_signoff records that coverage either way and is not an independent sign-off. The binding independent adversarial test verdict is QA's, in peer-review.json at Phase 4.

issue_number.description: Tracker issue number. Accepts a string for an experiment run (/pipeline --dry-run), which uses an exp-<slug> placeholder instead of opening a tracker issue, and null before an id exists.

requirement_checks.description: One entry per item in spec.requirements. Dev emits this before declaring Phase 3 done.

deferred.description: Every item Dev observed and did NOT fix, with the ref that proves it was written down somewhere durable. Recorded through scripts/deferral.mjs BEFORE this report is written; the ref is whatever that script printed, which is an issue URL under deferralTracker github/gitlab and a repo-relative path under deferralDir in directory mode. The pre-Phase-4 gate refuses a report whose deferred entry carries no ref its configured tracker can resolve, because 'routed to #N' claimed in an artifact and never written has happened across three consecutive rounds on one PR.

what.description: The item itself, specific enough that the next reader can act on it without this run's context.

reason.description: Why it was deferred. Usually the most valuable half: the reason is what stops the next person reaching the opposite conclusion.

tracker_ref.description: The ref scripts/deferral.mjs printed. An issue URL or #<n> for github/gitlab; a path under deferralDir for directory mode.

evidence.description: Where it lives: file:line, a failing case, a consumer the change does not reach.

qa_signoff.description: Coverage record of the QA-authored behavioral tests (committed first in Phase 3) plus any internal-unit tests Dev added. Filled in by Dev at completion. Not the binding sign-off; QA renders the binding adversarial verdict in peer-review.json at Phase 4. verdict retains PENDING_CI as a legal value for backward compatibility with archived runs, though current pipelines do not emit it.

experiment_id.description: Present only on an experiment run: the exp-<slug> placeholder id used in place of a tracker issue.
